scope: Regression_10 ablation with PHASE2_EXTRACT_ALL_ASSISTANT_TURNS disabled after Service Bus session-id fix.
caveats: This is an ablation, not a final heldout gate. The first attempt was interrupted by a Service Bus session_id length failure and then resumed after deploying b17e43b, so it is not a perfectly controlled A/B run.
The latency improvement versus all-assistant extraction is strong and mechanism-consistent: avg ~113.7s -> 55.2s, p90 ~208.3s -> 96.7s, max 328.2s -> 119.2s, and >240s ingests 3 -> 0.

The quality improvement from 7/10 to 9/10 is directional but underpowered because n=10, resumed execution, and one extra successful ingest make causality less certain. Do not overclaim it without repeat/noise-floor runs.
The result is still below the previous clean as-of regression_10 result of 10/10; do not proceed to heldout_50 until the remaining preference miss is understood or repeated within the noise protocol.
residue_raw_nonrefusal_events=1 had provenance contamination 0; treat as a caveat, not a hard contamination failure.
